responsibilities.name: provide shared scalar, texture, and color value types
currentOwners: crates/engine_core/src/types.rs::Pixels, Seconds, and TextureId own serialized value wrappers
crates/engine_core/src/color.rs::Color constructors and named constants own renderer-facing color values
crates/engine_core/src/prelude.rs::public re-exports define the supported convenience surface

responsibilities.name: transport typed ECS events
currentOwners: crates/engine_core/src/event_bus.rs::Event and EventBus<T> own event storage, draining, and mutable iteration
crates/engine_core/tests/suite/event_bus.rs::behavior tests cover ordering, isolation, draining, and IntoIterator
dependencies: Event implementors in engine_input, engine_audio, and engine_physics

responsibilities.name: provide clocks, delta time, and fixed-step accumulation
currentOwners: crates/engine_core/src/time.rs::Time, FakeClock, FixedDeltaClock, SystemClock, ClockRes, DeltaTime, and FixedTimestep own frame-time state
crates/engine_core/tests/suite/time.rs::behavior tests cover clock reset, fixed-step boundaries, caps, and ECS updates

responsibilities.name: represent 2D transforms and affine conversion
currentOwners: crates/engine_core/src/transform.rs::Transform2D owns position, rotation, scale, and Affine2 conversion
crates/engine_core/tests/suite/transform.rs::behavior tests cover defaults, composition, serialization, and signed scale

responsibilities.name: compute spring motion and ECS scale animation
currentOwners: crates/engine_core/src/spring.rs::spring_step owns one integration step and its tuple contract
crates/engine_core/src/scale_spring.rs::ScaleSpring and scale_spring_system own bounded substeps and convergence removal
crates/engine_core/tests/suite/{spring,scale_spring}.rs::behavior tests cover convergence, locking, caps, and boundaries

responsibilities.name: record frame and system profiling data
currentOwners: crates/engine_core/src/profiler.rs::FrameProfiler, ProfileScope, and private Record own timing buffers and CSV flushes
crates/engine_core/tests/suite/profiler.rs::behavior tests cover buffering, spans, flush intervals, append mode, and write failures

responsibilities.name: provide shared window configuration
currentOwners: crates/engine_core/src/window.rs::WindowConfig owns title, dimensions, vsync, and resize defaults
crates/engine_app/src/app.rs::App stores and exposes WindowConfig without redefining it

responsibilities.name: expose the engine error boundary
currentOwners: crates/engine_core/src/prelude.rs::EngineError is re-exported as part of the public surface
